newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE white sugar ends with pared gains nearby.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE white sugar ends with pared gains nearby.

text.p: White sugar futures slipped back from mid-afternoon peaks during routine late Monday trading, with the closely-watched nearby contracts ending off their highs but still steadier.
Traders said business was mixed throughout the session, and overall activity was slow to pick up following New York's re-opening after the Thanksgiving Day holiday.

March closed the session $0.70 higher at $304.60, while May ended at $304.50, up $0.50 from pre-weekend levels. Other contracts registered losses in modest total turnover of 1,458 lots. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8080
